1.name: B
1.text: You’re more resilient than I thought.

2.name: B
2.text: Still keeping that quiet but burning flame in your eyes.

4.name: B
4.text: This’ll probably be my last day here, getting tired of the food and cheap beer.

5.name: B
5.text: But it was nice coming to this city.

6.name: B
6.text: Makes me appreciate the other places I’ve been to.

10.name: B
10.text: I told you about leaving this dump before, right?

9.name: B
9.text: Why ARE you working here, anyways?

10.name: B
10.text: You look smart, not a common figure from a Xoxo Shop.

11.name: B
11.text: You should be in college, studying to be someone in life.

14.name: B
14.text: Don’t waste away in a place like this.

15.name: B
15.text: Damn shame if I see you here again in a couple of years.

17.name: B
17.text: You have to work to change your own situation, you know?

18.name: B
18.text: Can’t just leave it up to a miracle.

19.name: B
19.text: It’s your life, your hands on the wheel.

21.name: B
21.text: Ask yourself if you’re doing the right thing.

22.name: B
22.text: You don’t need to be a superhero or an icon of virtue.

23.name: B
23.text: Just figure out what’s important to yourself.

24.name: B
24.text: That’s it, I talked too much already.

25.name: B
25.text: I’ll see you again someday, if the cigs or a bike accident don’t get to me first.
